title: Power BI for production and operations surveillance
why: Daily production data hides early warnings — declines, deferments, downtime. Dashboards make them visible to the whole team.
what_is_different: Operational dashboards need daily refresh from historians or reports, allocation logic, deferment categories and exception-based views that point engineers to the wells or units that need attention.

extra_modules.title: Exception-based dashboards
extra_modules.outcome: You can: highlight the few items that need action
extra_modules.practice: Build a page listing wells with the largest deviation from forecast

starter_project: Build a daily production dashboard: actual vs forecast, deferment by cause, top losers with drill-through, refreshed automatically.
pitfalls: Manual refresh that stops when one person is away

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
